defects.title: Production HF/vLLM integration verification is not recorded
defects.observed_behavior: Current PSTF evidence is a D4 fake/no-network harness using fake Hugging Face artifact resolution, fake OCI/provenance state, fake GPU/vLLM provisioning, mocked Nostr read-model events, and UI smoke data.
defects.intended_behavior: Production readiness claims require real configured Hugging Face, artifact storage/provenance, GPU/vLLM runtime, gateway, live relay, and Nostr protocol verification evidence, or exact external blockers.
acceptance_criteria: PSTF distinguishes non-production D4 harness evidence from production evidence.
Production integration verification covers configured external dependencies or records exact blockers.
Nostr relay evidence validates OK, EOSE, CLOSED, AUTH, event signatures, and scoped filters rather than relying on mocked read-model inputs.
